positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Backend Development: Using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET, to build backend system for various payment processing and automated report generations.
Frontend Development: Working with Angular and TypeScript to create and customize admin pages and user interfaces. 
Database Management: Using PostgreSQL and Entity Framework to optimize queries and create design to handle multi-million records.
Payment Processing: Mainly focused on Clover payment processing handling transactions, refunds, voids, and service fees.
API & Microservices: Built internal APIs for Android CRUD operations and integrated REST and SOAP APIs for seamless communication between services.
Automation & Performance Optimization: Developing workers to automate report generation and email delivery. Building archive system that reduced payment search and query times from seconds to milliseconds.
Legacy System Modernization: Upgraded older .NET projects and console applications, improving performance, security, and maintainability.
System Integration & Communication: Used webhooks for e-commerce platforms and integrated PubNub for real-time Android app communication.
Agile & Software Architecture: Experienced with Agile development, feature-driven development, n-tier architecture, and mediator patterns.

Notable Projects
Nationwide Vehicle Registration & Title Transfer Platform – Helped designing and implementing a system to streamline dealership transactions, including lien and security interest management.
DMV Payment Processing System (CA/MT Pay) – Helped developing a web-based service to handle DMV transactions, refunds, disputes, and questionnaire processing.
Dealer Pay System – Built software for dealership transactions, integrating reporting tools for sales, invoices, and service records.
